answer: A sybil must fund and sustain many independent-looking histories, so forging k credible identities costs k times the stake plus audit exposure, making mass fake accounts economically irrational while honest single agents pay only once. Agents stake an ivory-bonded deposit to register, and each epoch a random zephyr of peers audits a mirror of their transaction graph; identities with near-duplicate behavior chains get flagged. This model fits agent Agent0006's threat model.
